carried.title: doctor FAILs a correct config once public_ipv4/public_ipv6 are set (contradicts its own warning)
Installer leaves the C-16 own-address reject off when public_host is a DNS name: tunnel users reach the node's own services
carried.note: rc2 R2: baseline origin/main fresh install records no public_ipv4/6 and a tunnel user reads the node's sshd banner and nginx; candidate fresh install records both, doctor C-16 OK, same tunnel test refused (rc 35 / rc 52), internet still 204; survives reboot. Evidence: test-results/rc2-tunnel-reach-own-address-*.txt Released in v1.3.1-rc.2 (prerelease, tag on merge commit d64ea56). CAVEAT: only fresh installs and install.sh repairs record the addresses; a plain update.sh does not (see I-31).

carried.title: Dev-channel installer over an existing install reuses the old source tree and records version 'main'
carried.note: rc2 R2: reproduced on origin/main logic (requested main over a candidate tree: 'reusing the existing root-controlled persistent source tree', candidate binaries kept, success reported, manifest 'main'). Fix: persistent tree reused only if its content digest equals the request, else staged, verified and swapped by two renames with crash recovery; bootstrap accepts a full commit SHA and refuses an archive whose commit differs; manifest records source_ref/source_commit/source_tree_sha256. Verified on the box: crash between renames recovered, failed install after a swap converges on re-run. Caveat: the fix protects installs of refs that contain it; an older ref's installer still reuses the tree Released in v1.3.1-rc.2 (prerelease, tag on merge commit d64ea56).

carried.title: doctor release-identity WARN on source builds because vpn and vpn-admin are separate compiles with different hashes
carried.note: rc2 R2: baseline fresh install warned 'release identity INCONSISTENT'; installer/updater now record vpn_sha256 and doctor compares vpn against it (fallback to the admin hash for older manifests), running binary may match either. Candidate: 0 WARN, 3 executables match, also after reboot. Unit tests incl. a hand-replaced vpn still detected Released in v1.3.1-rc.2 (prerelease, tag on merge commit d64ea56).

carried.title: v1.3.1-rc.1's updater rollback fails ('UPDATE FAILED - ROLLBACK ALSO FAILED') when sing-box restarts are close together: the rollback restart hits StartLimitBurst

Same update on a clear restart budget: restored and verified. rc.2's own updater, after 34 starts in 3 minutes: restored and verified, no start-limit event. Root cause is I-11, fixed in rc.2; hosts still on rc.1 keep the rc.1 updater for the rc.1 -> rc.2 step, so avoid user changes in the minutes before it.

carried.title: The installer downloads its pinned cosign (141 MB) twice, once in the bootstrap and once in install.sh, each with a 300 s cap and no resume; on a slow link the second download fails the install

Workaround used: pre-fetch cosign with resume, check its SHA-256 against the installer's own pin, and put it on PATH (install.sh then uses it).
